```{r load-packages, include=FALSE}
# Load required packages
library(vegan)
library(knitr)
```

## Load and Explore ASV Table

```{r load-data}
ASVs <- read.table("16S_Tomicro_2025_Rarefied_Table_1000_times_Clean_ASVnumbers_2.txt",
                   header = TRUE, sep = "\t", dec = ".", fill = FALSE)

# Replace NA with 0
ASVs[is.na(ASVs)] <- 0

# Preview ASV table
head(ASVs)
dim(ASVs)
```

## Calculate Relative Abundance

```{r relabund}
# Convert to % relative abundance
ASVs_rela <- sweep(ASVs, 1, rowSums(ASVs), FUN = "/") * 100
```

## Load and Clean Metadata

```{r metadata}
metadat <- read.table("Metadata_02_2025.txt", header = TRUE, row.names = 2, sep = "\t", quote = "\"")

# Clean whitespace and convert to factors
metadat$Plant.condition   <- factor(trimws(metadat$Plant.condition))
metadat$Soil.origin       <- factor(trimws(metadat$Soil.origin))
metadat$Microcompartment <- factor(trimws(metadat$Microcompartment))
metadat$Replicate         <- factor(trimws(metadat$Replicate))

View(metadat)
table(metadat$Plant.condition, metadat$Microcompartment, metadat$Soil.origin)
```

## Match Metadata with ASV Table

```{r align-samples}
# Filter out samples with zero abundance
non_empty <- rowSums(ASVs_rela) > 0
ASVs_rela <- ASVs_rela[non_empty, ]
metadat   <- metadat[rownames(metadat) %in% rownames(ASVs_rela), ]
ASVs_rela <- ASVs_rela[rownames(metadat), ]

# Confirm rownames match
stopifnot(identical(rownames(ASVs_rela), rownames(metadat)))
```

## Bray-Curtis Distance Matrix

```{r distance}
ASVs_rela_dist <- vegdist(ASVs_rela, method = "bray")
stopifnot(!any(is.na(ASVs_rela_dist)))
```

## PERMANOVA

```{r permanova}
adonis_result <- adonis2(
  ASVs_rela_dist ~ Plant.condition * Microcompartment * Soil.origin,
  data = metadat,
  permutations = 9999,
  by = "term"
)
adonis_result
```

## NMDS Ordination

```{r nmds}
NMDS_ASVs <- metaMDS(ASVs_rela_dist, distance = "bray", k = 2, try = 20, trymax = 100, trace = TRUE)
NMDS_ASVs
```

## NMDS Plot

```{r nmds-plot}
# Assign point shapes by Plant.condition
pch_vals <- ifelse(metadat$Plant.condition == "Healthy", 21, 24)

# Assign fill colors by Microcompartment and Soil.origin
color_map <- with(metadat, interaction(Microcompartment, Soil.origin))
palette <- c(
  "Rhizosphere.SoilA" = "#146eb4",
  "Rhizosphere.SoilB" = "#ff9900",
  "Phyllosphere.SoilA" = "#18D41B",
  "Phyllosphere.SoilB" = "#D4B518",
  "Endosphere.SoilA" = "#D418B5",
  "Endosphere.SoilB" = "#971C1C"
)
bg_vals <- palette[as.character(color_map)]

# Generate NMDS plot
plot(NMDS_ASVs, type = "n", display = "sites", choices = c(1, 2),
     xlim = c(-3, 3.5), ylim = c(-1.5, 1.5), bty = 'o', yaxt = "n")
axis(2, at = seq(-1.5, 1.5, by = 0.5), las = 1)

points(NMDS_ASVs, display = "sites", pch = pch_vals, bg = bg_vals)

legend("bottomleft", inset = c(0,0), xpd = TRUE, text.font = 1.5,
       legend = c("Rhizosphere SoilA", "Rhizosphere SoilB", "Phyllosphere SoilA",
                  "Phyllosphere SoilB", "Endosphere SoilA", "Endosphere SoilB"),
       col = "black", pt.bg = unname(palette),
       pch = c(21, 21, 21, 21, 21, 21), cex = 0.7, bty = "n")

legend("topleft", inset = c(0,0), xpd = TRUE, text.font = 1.5,
       legend = c("Healthy", "Diseased"),
       pch = c(21, 24), cex = 0.7, bty = "n")

#ordipointlabel(NMDS_ASVs, "sites", add = TRUE, cex = 0.6)
```

## Save the Plot

```{r save-plot}
png("output.png", width = 7, height = 7, units = "in", res = 300)

# Repeat plotting for export
plot(NMDS_ASVs, type = "n", display = "sites", choices = c(1, 2),
     xlim = c(-3, 3.5), ylim = c(-1.5, 1.5), bty = 'o', yaxt = "n")
axis(2, at = seq(-1.5, 1.5, by = 0.5), las = 1)
points(NMDS_ASVs, display = "sites", pch = pch_vals, bg = bg_vals)
legend("bottomleft", inset = c(0,0), xpd = TRUE, text.font = 1.5,
       legend = c("Rhizosphere SoilA", "Rhizosphere SoilB", "Phyllosphere SoilA",
                  "Phyllosphere SoilB", "Endosphere SoilA", "Endosphere SoilB"),
       col = "black", pt.bg = unname(palette),
       pch = c(21, 21, 21, 21, 21, 21), cex = 0.7, bty = "n")
legend("topleft", inset = c(0,0), xpd = TRUE, text.font = 1.5,
       legend = c("Healthy", "Diseased"),
       pch = c(21, 24), cex = 0.7, bty = "n")
ordipointlabel(NMDS_ASVs, "sites", add = TRUE, cex = 0.6)

dev.off()
```
